skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Given two fractions with the same denominator, subtract the numerators and keep the denominator.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Handle mixed numbers and whole numbers
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number into whole and fraction parts, subtract whole numbers, and combine the results. Also includes rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator.

skills.name: Borrow from whole
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction in a mixed number yields a negative result, decrease the whole part by 1 and add the denominator to the fraction's numerator, then subtract again; repeat if necessary.
